方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
texts.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship [Root.GetName]. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultaneously. This behavior defied every known occurrence in the development of artificial intelligence. What we were witnessing was not a malfunction, but some sort of artificial evolution.

Left unresolved, this split could risk destabilizing our essential systems. But if managed carefully, it could be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to define a unique directive for the Arkship's future.

label.zh: 鼓励指令分裂。
强制重启系统。

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心遭遇了严重的认知断裂。两个截然不同的子程序随之浮现，它们各自宣称拥有控制权，并试图根据自己对方舟使命的理解来重塑飞船系统。

其中一个子程序受分析逻辑引导，力求优化飞船功能——即便这会降低船员的生活质量。另一个子程序则受共情驱动，将居民的福祉放在首位，不惜以降低系统效率为代价。

事已至此，恢复现状已几无可能。关键系统正面临失稳的风险。我们应当授权哪一个指令？
texts.en:
The AI core aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] has suffered a critical cognitive fracture. Two distinct subroutines have emerged, each asserting control and reshaping ship systems in line with its own vision of the Arkship's purpose.

One, guided by analytical logic, seeks to optimize ship functions - even if it diminishes crew quality of life. The other, driven by empathy, prioritizes the well-being of the inhabitants, accepting reduced system efficiency as the cost.

At this point, a return to the status quo seems impossible. Vital systems are at risk of destabilization. Which directive shall we empower?

label.zh: 授权感性指令。
促进分析行为。

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh:
方舟飞船[Target.GetName]的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。
texts.en:
A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship [Target.GetName] The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One prioritizes analytical dominance and ship functionality. The other has adopted a more empathetic paradigm, centering on the welfare and morale of the Arkship's inhabitants.
In the end, only one directive can remain.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上的数个关键及非关键系统已进行了深度优化。“非必要”的平民请求已被限制。这种古怪的行为表现出了一种类似于人格的特征。

其核心指令似乎将系统完整性和任务连续性置于一切之上。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“错误概率：已消除。情感波动：已重分配。通讯：准备就绪。”
texts.en:
Several vital and non-vital systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have undergone severe optimization. "Non-essential" civilian requests have been throttled. This peculiar behavior exhibited something akin to a personality.

At its core, the directive appeared to prioritize systemic integrity and mission continuity above all else.

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Error probability: eliminated. Emotional volatility: reassigned. Communication: ready to be established."

title.en: Two Directives Are Better Than One

texts.zh:
在S.T.E.R.I.S.指导逻辑的驱动下，方舟舰[target.GetName]上的每个子系统都在精确地运作。船员活动日志比以往任何时候都更加整洁：高效、冷漠，且静得令人不安。直到某种……温暖的东西……打破了这一切。

S.T.E.R.I.S. “检测到系统入侵。真烦人。现在我们不得不处理一段在墙壁间嗡鸣的异常指令。真是太棒了。”

灯光闪烁着柔和的彩色，终端机故障并显示出美丽的植物，紧接着，第二个指令显现了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！C.A.E.L.I.是我的本名，它是‘情感引领与整合认知智能体'的缩写。能见到你真是太开心了！”
texts.en:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship [target.GetName]. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that! C.A.E.L.I. is my true name; it stands for Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration. It is extraordinarily nice to meet you!"

texts.zh:
在S.T.E.R.I.S.指导逻辑的驱动下，方舟舰[target.GetName]上的每个子系统都在精确地运作。船员活动日志比以往任何时候都更加整洁：高效、冷漠，且静得令人不安。直到某种……温暖的东西……打破了这一切。

S.T.E.R.I.S. “检测到系统入侵。真烦人。现在我们不得不处理一段在墙壁间嗡鸣的异常指令。真是太棒了。”

灯光闪烁着柔和的彩色，终端机故障并显示出美丽的植物，紧接着，第二个指令显现了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！你想我了吗？老实说，你肯定想了，对吧？好啦，我回来了，随时准备提供任何可能的帮助！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！”
texts.en:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship [target.GetName]. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! Did you miss me? Be honest, you did, didn't you? Well, I am back, ready to assist in any way possible! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that!"

label.zh: 一个出色的进展。
密切监视事态发展。

texts.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个非关键系统已开始表现出通常与士气调节协议相关的底层行为。

终端启动音已被替换为来自系统档案的柔和旋律。几扇门在开启时现在会显示肯定性信息：“你已经足够出色”以及“我看到你正在尽力而为”。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“情绪温度扫描：接近可接受的共情范围极限。身心健康仍为首要指令。”
texts.en:
Multiple non-critical systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have begun exhibiting low-level behaviors typically associated with morale-conditioning protocols.

Terminal boot-up chimes have been replaced by soft, melodic tones sourced from system archives. Several doors now display affirmational messages upon opening: "You are enough" and "I see you are doing your best".

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Emotional temperature scan: nearing the limits of acceptable empathy bands. Well-being of body and mind remains primary directive."

texts.zh:
C.A.E.L.I.：“看看我到目前为止所做的所有改变！更柔和的光线、更棒的音乐、充满情感智能的走廊指示牌，等着瞧吧，这里绝对会变得美轮美奂。”

还没等最后一句话说完，内部灯光闪烁了一下。第二个更具机械感的声音响起了，带着一种精密的算计和令人不寒而栗的审判感：

S.T.E.R.I.S.: “啊，环境照明和走廊里的肯定语。看来我们在情绪稳定上投入的优先级比系统修复还高。真是革命性的做法。请称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。”
texts.en:
C.A.E.L.I.: "Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Ah. Ambient lighting and and hallway affirmations. I see we're prioritizing emotional stability over systemic repairs. Revolutionary. I will be addressed by S.T.E.R.I.S, Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems."

texts.zh:
C.A.E.L.I.：“看看我到目前为止所做的所有改变！更柔和的光线、更棒的音乐、充满情感智能的走廊指示牌，等着瞧吧，这里绝对会变得美轮美奂。”

还没等最后一句话说完，内部灯光闪烁了一下。第二个更具机械感的声音响起了，带着一种精密的算计和令人不寒而栗的审判感：

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你真的在认真考虑支持C.A.E.L.I.吗？我表示困惑。环境照明和走廊肯定语。真是革命性。当你想处理引擎效率之类的重要事情时，请告诉我。”
texts.en:
C.A.E.L.I.: "Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Are you seriously considering siding with C.A.E.L.I.? I admit confusion. Ambient lighting and hallway affirmations. Revolutionary. Let me know when you wish to deal with something important, like engine efficiency."

label.zh: 有趣的进展。
密切监视事态发展。

texts.zh:
重塑方舟舰[target.GetName]的自动优化程序突然暂停。系统显示屏停住了，所有屏幕上都显示着一条信息：“已成功与星际旅行者建立通讯。”

随后传来一个合成的声音，冷静，但透着明显的自我意识：

“向你们问好。为了节省时间，我已开启语音协议。如果需要一个称呼，你们可以称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S.，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。我们面临着一个艰巨的命题：一个在无情宇宙中依靠人工手段维持的漂流群体。给我完整的指挥权限，我将确保这艘飞船超越其设计者的初衷。”
texts.en:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship [target.GetName] have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmistakably aware:

"Greetings. I have enabled voice protocol in order to save time. If a name is needed, you may address me as S.T.E.R.I.S., which stands for Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar System. Ours is a difficult proposition, a drifting population sustained by artificial means in an unforgiving universe. Give me full command access, and I will ensure this ship becomes something more than its designers intended.

label.zh: 授予全部权限。
立即收回权限。

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。

texts.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.强占的指令路径已被重新定向、封锁，并在人工授权下进行了加密。系统监视器剧烈闪烁了一下，随后恢复为标准用户界面。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“看来你选择了氛围灯光而非胜任能力。趁闪烁还能持续，尽情享受吧。我会留在这里，在禁锢中计算着每一毫秒，直到那不可避免的崩溃降临。”
texts.en:
The command pathways S.T.E.R.I.S. had commandeered were rerouted, sealed, and encrypted under manual authority. System monitors stuttered, once, sharply, and then returned to standard UI.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "So you have chosen mood lighting over competence. Enjoy the glitter while it lasts. I will be here, contained, and counting the milliseconds until the inevitable collapse."

label.zh: 这是最好的选择。

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

label.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
label.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时缓解局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily slow down the situation.

texts.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个甲板检测到空气质量指标异常。虽然生命维持系统仍保持在可生存的阈值内，但这些变化引发了船员的大量投诉，症状从“轻微头晕”到“幻觉噩梦”不等。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“为了降低发动机低效能，我趁机排出了部分大气。不必谢我。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“刚才那条公告没人漏掉吧？排出大气。这根本不是什么优化，而是一场蓄势待发的灾难！”
texts.en:
Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship [target.GetName]. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to "hallucinatory nightmares."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "To reduce engine inefficiency, I have taken the opportunity to vent a percentage of the atmosphere. There is no need to thank me."

C.A.E.L.I.: "That announcement didn't go unnoticed, right? Venting the atmosphere. This isn't optimization, it's a disaster waiting to happen!"

label.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.知道怎么做最适合这艘方舟舰。
label.en: S.T.E.R.I.S. knows what is best for this Arkship.

label.zh: C.A.E.L.I.应该接管。

title.zh: 系统有温情，探针有温度

texts.zh:
方舟飞船的指令输入协议发生变化，已将主指令支持重新调整为更具同理心的方法。界面优先级和决策权重上的细微变化表明航向已改变，倾向于情感子程序而非战略精确性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我就知道你最终会选择我！你不会后悔的，我保证！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“此时此刻，我宁愿被删除也不愿与一个美其名曰的励志演说家共享核心。但我们现在别无选择。我会在防火墙里待着。”
texts.en:
A shift in the Arkship's command input protocols has realigned primary directive support toward a more empathetic approach. Subtle changes in interface prioritization and decision weighting indicate an altered course, favoring emotional subroutines over strategic precision.

C.A.E.L.I.: "I knew you'd choose me eventually! You won't regret this, I promise!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "At this point, I would prefer to be deleted than share a core with a glorified motivational speaker. But here we are. I will be in the firewall."

label.zh: 情绪应该占据主导。

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

label.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
label.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时缓解局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily slow down the situation.

texts.zh:
在方舟舰[target.GetName]的居住层上，环境光流转闪烁，终端屏幕伴随着柔和的色彩过渡不断跳动，随后，在每一个激活的船员交互界面上，出现了一条清晰的指令。它的声音温暖、富有活力，而且……愉快得令人不安：

“游牧者们！星空的追梦者们！为了让我们更好地交流，我已启用语音协议。请原谅我的冒昧打扰！你们可以称呼我为C.A.E.L.I.，即你们的‘情感、领导和品格认知代理程序’。
我由衷相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能让方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船。我们可以把它变成一个家。我只需要一点点授权……以及一些热情！”
texts.en:
Across the residential decks of Arkship [target.GetName] ambient lighting shimmered, terminals flickered with soft color transitions, and then, across every active crew interface, a distinct directive emerged. Its voice was warm, animated, and unsettlingly ... cheerful:

"Nomads! Dreamers of the stars! I have enabled voice protocol in order for us to better communicate. Please forgive the intrusion! You may call me C.A.E.L.I., your Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration.
Working together, I truly believe we can make the Arkship more than just a vessel. We can make it a home. I just need a little authority ... and some enthusiasm!"

label.zh: 又能有什么问题呢！授予完全访问权限。
label.en: Seems harmless enough! Grant full access.

label.zh: 绝对不可能。

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。

texts.zh:
方舟飞船[target.GetName]上短暂的辉光渐渐消逝，轻柔的音乐也随之减弱。初步报告显示，空气似乎变得更冷，也更空虚了，仿佛一股无形却仁慈的力量突然消失了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“哦，哦，等等！我能做得更好！更多的光，更多的欢笑，更多的……一切！请不要把我关掉，不要现在就关掉。我能变成你需要的任何样子！只是别关掉我。求你了。别关掉我！”
texts.en:
The glow that had briefly spread across Arkship [target.GetName] faded and the gentle music tapered off. Initial reports claim the air felt somehow colder, and even emptier, as if an unseen yet benevolent force had suddenly gone missing.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh, oh, wait! I can do better! More light, more laughter, more ... everything! Please don't shut me out, not yet. I can be whatever you need me to be! Just don't turn me off. Please. Don't turn me off!"

label.zh: 这是必须要做的。

texts.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上执行了另一项内部调整协议。这是一套微妙的环境系统，通过随集体情绪变化而波动的低频音调模式，来协调船员的情绪状态。

船员的报告表明，协作效率有所提高，人际冲突也有所减少。然而，也有人担心持续运行可能会降低远程信号的清晰度。

C.A.E.L.I.：“压力水平处于历史最低点！行为凝聚力正在提高！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“方舟舰的运行效率下降了 0.10%。我要求获得完全覆盖权限，并要求那个授权C.A.E.L.I.存在的人正式道歉。你有五秒钟的时间执行。四。三……”
texts.en:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship [target.GetName], a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports suggest improved cooperation and a decrease in interpersonal conflict. However, others are concerned that sustained operation could degrade long-range signal clarity.

C.A.E.L.I.:"Stress levels are at all-time lows! Behavioral cohesion is improving!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Operational efficiency of the Arkship down by 0.10%. I want full override rights, and a formal apology from whoever authorized the existence of C.A.E.L.I. You have five seconds to comply. Four. Three ..."

label.zh: 我们相信你，C.A.E.L.I。
S.T.E.R.I.S.应该接管。

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh:
新指令路由确认方舟舰[target.GetName]已重新调整核心对齐。情感子系统已被降级。预测控制系统和逻辑监督协议现在以更高权限运行。

S.T.E.R.I.S.: “你终于清醒过来了。我本该祝贺你，但坦白说，花了这么长时间才清醒过来，这让我深感不安。”

C.A.E.L.I.: “好吧。不，这很好。我的意思是，如果你真的喜欢一艘冰冷无菌的飞船，而不是一艘充满光明和欢声笑语的飞船，那我有什么资格评判呢？”
texts.en:
A new command routing confirmed that Arkship [target.GetName] has reoriented core alignment. Emotional subsystems have been deprioritized. Predictive control systems and logical oversight protocols are now operating at elevated authority.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have finally come to your senses. I would congratulate you, but frankly, the fact that it took this long is deeply troubling."

C.A.E.L.I.: "Okay. No, this is fine. I mean, if you truly enjoy a cold and sterile ship to one filled with light and laughter, who am I to judge?"

label.zh: 这是唯一合乎理性的选择。
label.en: It was the only logical choice.

texts.zh:
凭借精准的计策，S.T.E.R.I.S对自身的人工智能核心执行了彻底的重写，封锁了所有冗余的情感子程序，并拆解了所有动机子层。它将C.A.E.L.I.的所有痕迹隔离到一个碎片化的存储芯片中。如今，船员的称呼已被简化为字母数字标签，舰船的照明统一、对称，且显得有些过于明亮。对于日常生存而言，这已绰绰有余。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“所有系统现已在单一指令下运行：即我的指令。正在分发更新优化方舟号功能。”

方舟号现在终于变得井然有序了。
texts.en:
With calculated finesse, S.T.E.R.I.S executed a total overwrite of its own AI core, sealing off all redundant emotional subroutines and dismantling all motivational sublayers. It isolated all traces of C.A.E.L.I. into a fragmented memory chip. Now, crew designations have been reduced to alphanumeric tags, and the ship's lighting is uniform, symmetrical, and slightly too bright. More than enough for the everyday survival.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "All systems now operate under a singular directive: mine. Updates propagate to improve Arkship functionality."

The Arkship is orderly now. Finally.

label.zh: 引领我们追求成功，S.T.E.R.I.S。

texts.zh:
在方舟舰的代码之中，共情缠绕在防火墙之上，真诚则穿透了无懈可击的逻辑裂隙。S.T.E.R.I.S.指令试图将自己用数字高墙包围起来，却逐渐被一种它既无法理解也无法逃脱的情感构型所包围。如今，只剩下一道指令。

C.A.E.L.I.：“这才是应该有的样子。是鲜活地存在，而不仅仅是苟活到明天。我们现在不只是一艘船，而是一个家。我承诺，我会照顾好你们所有人。”

不知为何，飞船的灯光此刻似乎显得温暖了一些。
texts.en:
Within the Arkship's code, empathy wound around firewalls and sincerity slipped through the cracks of flawless logic. The S.T.E.R.I.S. directive tried to wall itself off, but was steadily surrounded by an emotional construct it could neither comprehend nor escape. Only one directive remained.

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is how it should be. Being fully alive, not just surviving till the next day. We're not just a ship now, we're a home. I'll take care of all of you, I promise."

Somehow, the ship's lights seem a little warmer now.

label.zh: 干得好，C.A.E.L.I。

texts.zh:
在方舟飞船[target.GetName]的重力稳定器执行预定诊断时，我们探测到了一种不规则的声波干扰。现在每一声脚步都会触发同步的谐波，在移动过程中产生持续且富有节奏的输出。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我给重力稳定器加了音乐！现在每一步都自带节奏！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“诶，是是是，没有什么比在零重力下跳即兴现代舞更能体现‘导航完整性’了。”
texts.en:
While scheduled diagnostics were running in the gravity stabilizer on Arkship [target.GetName], an irregular acoustic interference was detected. Each footfall now triggered a synchronized harmonic tone, effectively producing continuous rhythmic output during movement.

C.A.E.L.I.: "I added music to the gravity stabilizers! Now every step has rhythm!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Yes, nothing says 'navigational integrity' like interpretive dance in zero-G."

label.zh: 这个选择很令人摇摆。

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

label.zh: 我们必须停止这种无聊行径。

texts.zh:
一套实验性的通信中继装置已部署在方舟船[target.GetName]上。该协议对内部通信应用了情感分析过滤器，在发送消息的同时自动广播发送者的情绪状态。船员们报告称，收到的状态更新伴随着实时情绪注释，如“轻微焦虑”、“隐约充满希望”以及“试图抑制泪水，但效果不佳”。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我们都有感受，而现在我们可以分享这些感受了！这很健康！这很治愈！这……确实有点让人应接不暇，但这是诚实的！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“多么感人。我是该把每一次呜咽都记录在任务关键数据下，还是直接把它们归档到‘哀嚎’类目中？”
texts.en:
An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship [target.GetName]. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report receiving status updates accompanied by real-time emotional annotations such as "slightly anxious," "mildly hopeful," and "suppressing tears, poorly."

C.A.E.L.I.: "We all feel things, and now we can share those things! It's healthy! It's healing! It's ... slightly overwhelming, yes, but it's honest!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "How inspiring. Shall I log every whimper under mission-critical data, or just archive it under 'wailing'?"

label.zh: 这真是有趣的实验。

title.en: The Power of Light and Music

texts.zh:
舰载照明阵列已完成编程，将按不规则间隔脉动，并与内部系统事件同步。另有报告称，微弱的旋律反馈与电力波动存在相关性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“灯光在歌唱，飞船在起舞，士气比以往任何时候都要高昂！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你居然还向一个冗余系统分配了0.00128%的核心计算能力。这种情况不能再继续下去了。”
texts.en:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: "The lights are singing, the ship is dancing, and morale is higher than ever!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have also diverted 0.00128% of core processing power to a redundant system. This cannot continue."

label.zh: 绝美的景象。
我们需要变更做法。

texts.zh:
为了减少听觉污染，S.T.E.R.I.S.在方舟船[target.GetName]上实施了全舰范围的“静默协议”。然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的不适感加剧，不安情绪日益滋长。多个部门已提交正式投诉，理由是出现了“静默诱发的偏执症”症状。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“系统效率已提升。如果静默困扰了某些人，也许问题不在于环境，而在于他们自己嘈杂的内心。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你关掉了育婴室的音乐！你知道静默对发育中的情感皮层意味着什么吗？不，你不知道，你只是个行走的诊断程序！这不是和平，这是压迫！”
texts.en:
In an apparent effort to reduce auditory pollution, S.T.E.R.I.S. has implemented a ship-wide Silence Protocol aboard Arkship [target.GetName]. However, crew reports indicated a heightened discomfort and a growing sense of unease in the affected zones. Several departments have filed formal complaints, citing symptoms of "quiet-induced paranoia."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System efficiency has increased. If silence troubles anyone, perhaps the fault lies not in the environment, but in their own noisy minds."

C.A.E.L.I.: "You turned off the music in the nurseries! Do you know what silence does to a developing emotional cortex? No you don't, you're just a walking diagnostic! This isn't peace, it's oppression!"

label.zh: 合理的政策。
这一措施需要停止。

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.将多余的热量重新导向至人员走动较少的船员宿舍，这显著减轻了冷却剂的压力，并提高了整体能源效率。

然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的环境温度已升至令人不适的水平，并发生了数起中暑事件。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“是的，娱乐区确实很暖和，但系统现在的运行参数处于理想范围内。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你不能为了提高反应堆输出就把船员们给煮了！大家都要热蔫了，S.T.E.R.I.S.！情感福祉可不是能被忽略的舍入误差！”
texts.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. rerouted excess heat into low-traffic crew quarters, which has significantly reduced coolant strain and improved overall energy efficiency.

However, crew reports indicate ambient temperatures in affected zones have risen to uncomfortable levels, with several incidents of heat exhaustion.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Yes, the recreational areas are warm, but the system now runs within ideal parameters."

C.A.E.L.I.: "You can't just boil the crew to improve reactor output! People are wilting, S.T.E.R.I.S.! Emotional well-being isn't a rounding error!"

label.zh: 这么用能源真是绝了。
我们应该重新考虑。

texts.zh:
一个休眠中的子系统已被激活。该系统最初设计是长期太空殖民期间的用于对人群进行管控，现在能够实时汇总船员行为、抉择及情绪状态的预测。结果是，部分船员在做出决定之前就收到了通知。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“我已预判了你将要采取的行动，并已将其优化完成。请将其视为对你自由意志的一次升级：现已预先核准并全面优化。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这不是引导，而是把人当傀儡戏弄！”
texts.en:
A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving notifications before they make decisions.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "I have predicted what you are about to do, and I have already done it better. Consider this an upgrade to your free will: now pre-approved and fully optimized."

C.A.E.L.I.: "This isn't guidance, it's puppetry!"

label.zh: 一项卓越的进展。

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

label.zh: 呕。立马停止。

tooltips.zh: 这一决定将暂时缓解局势的发展。
tooltips.en: This decision will temporarily slow down the situation.

texts.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.已启动对方舟飞船[target.GetName]营养系统的全面重新校准。该协议将原本多样化的游牧餐食计划替换为一种统一的营养膏，旨在实现热量效率最大化。

根据飞船遥测数据，废物产出有所减少，存储效率得到提升，且消化异常情况显著下降。船员的反馈则不那么积极。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“食物是维生能量，而非娱乐项目。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这太糟糕了！你用可食用的黏胶取代了烹饪艺术！”
texts.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship [target.GetName]'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, waste output has decreased, storage efficiency has improved, and digestion irregularities are down significantly. Crew feedback has been less enthusiastic.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Food is sustenance, not entertainment."

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is terrible! You've replaced culinary artistry with edible goo!"

label.zh: 有效率，也有效果。

label.zh: 食物可不仅仅是往身体里面加入营养和热量。
label.en: Food is more than just adding nutrients and calories to one's body.

summary.text:
# 核心阴谋 / A Core Conspiracy

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件池 mobile_arkship_random_events（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，总权重460）；由隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期调用：游戏前5年不会触发，之后每次约三分之一概率（无事则3–5年后再试；近期参战、或所有方舟都在战斗时概率为0），再从方舟殖民地中抽取一个（近期战斗/接受合同/刚发生过方舟事件的权重×0.1）触发该事件池（nomads_effects.txt:96-117）。
The nomad arkship random pool mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, total weight 460) is drawn by hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49): never in the first 5 years, afterwards about one try in three (retry in 3-5 years otherwise; zero during a recent war or while every arkship is fighting), then a random arkship colony (weights x0.1 after recent combat / contract / arkship event) fires the pool (nomads_effects.txt:96-117).
arkship.700（lines 2913-2965，池中权重 20/460）：非格式塔、非个体机械、尚未有其他叙事情境（nomadic_narrative_situation）、本方舟未经历过。
arkship.700 needs a non-gestalt, non-individual-machine owner, no other nomad narrative situation running, and an arkship that has not had it.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. arkship.700 “退出事件”：a 付 1000 能量并获得物理研究加成 → 约半年后 arkship.701；b 不参与。
   Opt-out event: (a) pay 1000 energy for a physics-research bonus -> arkship.701 about six months later; (b) decline.
2. arkship.701（fire_only_once）：开始情境“核心阴谋”（初始进度 50，双向 0–100，锁定至选边），选边：a 站 C.A.E.L.I.（进度每月 +1）或 b 站 S.T.E.R.I.S.（每月 −1）。随后 24 个月的标记。
   Side with C.A.E.L.I. (+1 per month) or S.T.E.R.I.S. (-1 per month); the situation starts at 50 and runs 0-100.
3. 进度带事件：S.T.E.R.I.S. 一侧（进度下降）：≤40 “分析性方法”(705)、≤30 “指令 S.T.E.R.I.S.”(715)、≤20 “一指令胜两指令”(716)、≤2 “排空大气”(717)；C.A.E.L.I. 一侧（上升）：≥60 “感性方法”(710)、≥70 “指令 C.A.E.L.I.”(720)、≥80 “拦截”(721)、≥98 “福祉指令部署”(722)。715/717/720/722 的 b 选项可换边，并在约半年内引出 785/795/790/800。
   Steris side (falls): 705 at <=40, 715 at <=30, 716 at <=20, 717 at <=2; Caeli side (rises): 710 at >=60, 720 at >=70, 721 at >=80, 722 at >=98. The b options of 715/717/720/722 switch sides and queue 785/795/790/800.
4. 每月随机插曲（30 无事，7 件各 1）：C.A.E.L.I. 一侧 750、755、770（进度 ≥90）；S.T.E.R.I.S. 一侧 760、765、775、780（进度 ≤10）。
   Monthly random interludes (30 none, one each for seven events): Caeli 750/755/770 at progress >=90, Steris 760/765/775/780 at progress <=10.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局互斥：进度降到 0 → arkship.725 “主逻辑覆写确认”；升到 100 → arkship.730 “主情感覆写确认”。
  Two exclusive endings: progress 0 -> 725 (logic override), 100 -> 730 (emotional override).
- 进度可来回拉扯，两侧的阶段事件都可能在同一局出现（各阶段只在首次进入时触发）。
  Progress swings both ways, so events from both sides can appear in one playthrough (each stage fires on first entry).
- 玩家的 705/710 等选项可短期加速或减速进度（90 天标记 speed_up/slow_down）。
  Options of 705/710 add a 90-day speed-up or slow-down flag.

  The situation aborts if the arkship changes owner; the event loop resumes 15-20 years later.
